input.summary: Insert a transition-assistance and data-return clause in Section 10
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 10 ends the Services without any exit help or data return, so we add a short clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return of Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after that return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days.

ops.text: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months after that expiry or termination at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty days after that expiry or termination, return all Customer Data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after that return, delete Customer Data from its systems and certify the deletion in writing.
